sources_lede: Where each phrase comes from and the licence it is used under. An unreviewed draft has not yet been checked against a source.
licence_draft: Unreviewed draft: source and licence to be confirmed
settings_lede: Choose how the site looks. Your choices stay on this device and are never sent anywhere.
settings_no_script: Settings need scripts to be switched on in your browser. Without them the site follows your device's light or dark setting and uses the default colours.
appearance_hint: Light, dark, or follow your device.
order_hint: Simplest first, or most advanced first. A screen whose tiles you have arranged yourself keeps your order.
keys_hint: Mark the words that match across the two languages, by colour or by underline. Colour is not offered with High contrast or Monochrome.
access_hint: Choose which colour schemes are offered below.
access_safe_hint: Colours that stay easy to tell apart with colour-blind vision, or with none.
colours_hint: Pick one. The small pictures show how each looks in the current mode.
colours_only: Only one scheme at this level so far. More appear here when a palette is added for it.
search_hint: Type a word or phrase in {first} or {second}.
search_error: The word list could not be loaded.
arrange_hint: Drag a tile to move it, or tap one and tap where it goes. Save order keeps the new order.
arrange_picked: {name} picked up, place {n} of {total}. Use the arrow keys, or tap where it goes.
arrange_failed: The order could not be saved on this device.
reset_orders_lede: Put every tile on every page back in its default order. Your appearance and colour choices are kept.
reset_orders_done: Every tile is back in its default order.
how_to_lede: Short answers about how the app works, a chapter at a time.
help_failed: The help could not be loaded. Use the link to read the chapter.
help_report_lede: This is the email that will be written. The app sends nothing: you send it from your own mail app.
help_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
